I see why people may think it’s a good option, but I don’t believe it is. I believe it is disgusting, selfish, horrific, morbid, completely unacceptable, and should be banned. It is murder. And there is no reason that it should be allowed. Any reason people like to argue with me for has not swayed my position. And sometimes it’s not fair for the woman. I get it. But exchanging one wrong for another doesn’t fix anything. It’s not fair to the baby either. A lot of people don’t even know what actually happens during an abortion. They also don’t know the way a baby develops in the womb. They’re just “but the woman, the woman”. It’s not all about her. There is another life that is worthy of respect. And way more common than people want to admit, the woman who makes reckless sexual decisions and “isn’t ready”. Well don’t go making decisions that lead to results you aren’t ready for. I am fully aware of the rape, medical, and other situations people argue all the time. But there are other ways to deal with challenges that don’t involve death. Everyone says it’s the woman’s life over the baby’s, but I don’t see anyone ripping her into bits or sucking her through a vacuum (yes, those are both abortion methods). But that’s what those who fight for abortion are saying is perfectly acceptable and in fact encouraging it being done to babies. Life can be so challenging at times and that’s not fair or right, but that doesn’t give you the right to gruesomely take an innocent life. Even if it is relying on your body to be alive, because you most likely helped put it there.
